welcome.title: Light dey? Tell your neighbours.
welcome.body: Use two taps to report if light dey for your area. As we dey do am together, everybody go see wetin really dey happen: when light come, when e go, and how many hours your area dey get.

consent.before: As you tap this button, you agree to our
consent.after: . You dey confirm say you don reach 18, or your parent or guardian don allow you.

spot.title: Which place you want make we dey track light?
spot.useLocation: Use my location show me areas
spot.locationNote: Na only your phone go use am to suggest areas near you. We no dey save or share where you dey.
spot.locating: I dey find areas near you…
spot.locationDenied: No wahala. Just search your area.
spot.locationNone: We never see area near you. Search yours.
spot.noResults: We no see the area. Try another spelling, or browse by state.
spot.noAreasYet: We never reach {lga} yet. Light Dey? dey start for Abuja and Lagos, more places dey come.
spot.wholeArea: Whole area (e good for most people)
spot.addSpot: My street or estate no dey here
spot.exists: That spot don dey this area already. Choose am from the list.
spot.label: Save am as
spot.full: You don save 3 spots already. Remove one for home screen first.

extras.title: Small extra details (you fit skip)
extras.bandHelp: You fit see am for your light bill or meter. If you no sure, skip am.
extras.alreadySet: This spot don get these details already. Thank you!
extras.notify: Make we ping you when light come back
extras.notifyNote: Light alerts dey come soon. If you get iPhone, you go first add the app to Home Screen.
